name: Mean Reversion Commodity Theme
description: Short-term mean reversion (20-day contrarian) applied to commodities and precious metals only. Ranks SSLN, SGLN, COMM, BRNT, CRUD, WCOA, AIGC by trailing return, overweighting recent underperformers scaled by inverse volatility. Exploits short-horizon price reversal in commodity markets for inflation-sensitive mean-reversion edge.
